memories.text: Issue naming convention: Master Issues: MF-StMa_IssueTitle, Standard Issues: MF-StIs_IssueTitle, User-created Issues: MF-User_IssueTitle, Sub-Issues: __MF-SubI_IssueTitle.
Descriptions for Jules AI must be extremely detailed. Use local CLI agents for small bugfixes, scripts, and CI tasks to save Jules sessions.
In case of PR merge conflicts use a CLI Tool for fixing the conflicts manually
Source of Truth of all Autopilot Issues are the Vorce Github Issues, Changes only in the @Vorce Project Manager

Vorce Autopilot Token Consumption and Development Efficiency: Use as much as possible, but only as little as necessary. (Individual selection of Thinking Level & Model Tier based on the specific task)
